description: Defines the PaintCanvasVideoRenderer class responsible for rendering VideoFrames onto PaintCanvases, including methods for painting, copying, converting to RGB pixels, and managing GPU textures. It also includes internal structures for caching video frame data and handling YUV to RGB conversion.

classes.name: PaintCanvasVideoRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of VideoFrames to PaintCanvases, including painting, copying, converting, and texture management.

methods.name: Paint
methods.description: Paints a VideoFrame onto a PaintCanvas with specified transformations and context.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies a VideoFrame scaled to its visible rect onto a PaintCanvas.

methods.name: ConvertVideoFrameToRGBPixels
methods.description: Converts a VideoFrame to raw RGBA pixels with optional premultiplied alpha and chroma filtering.

methods.name: GetRGBPixelsOutputFormat
methods.description: Returns the output format for RGB pixel conversion.

methods.name: CopyVideoFrameTexturesToGLTexture
methods.description: Copies a VideoFrame's texture to a specified OpenGL texture.

methods.name: PrepareVideoFrameForWebGL
methods.description: Prepares a VideoFrame for WebGL texture upload.

methods.name: CopyVideoFrameYUVDataToGLTexture
methods.description: Copies YUV data from a VideoFrame to a GL texture.

methods.name: TexImage2D
methods.description: Uploads VideoFrame data to a texture using texImage2D.

methods.name: TexSubImage2D
methods.description: Updates a portion of a texture with VideoFrame data using texSubImage2D.

methods.name: ResetCache
methods.description: Releases cached resources for performance optimization.

methods.name: LastImageDimensionsForTesting
methods.description: Returns the dimensions of the last painted image for testing purposes.
